name: Pyromancer: Draconic Aspect dismounts on cast and is cancelled by mounting (COA-7766)
contract: Draconic Aspect (802117) shows the Dracthyr model 142067 while its aura is active; display 142067 uses
Entering the form on a mount dismounts the caster and the form stays on. 802117 carries
SPELL_ATTR0_ALLOW_WHILE_MOUNTED, which exempts it from the engine's mounted-cast prevention at
Spell.cpp:6130-6139; Spell::CheckCasterAuras instead dismounts the caster and clears SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED,
then the cast completes normally, so the mount display is gone, the aura is up and the Dracthyr model is
shown. A taxi flight is the exception and is still answered with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_ON_TAXI (65).
Mounting while the form is active cancels the form and returns the native model. Because display 142067
cannot be mounted, Unit::IsInDisallowedMountForm used to report true and Spell::CheckCast refused the mount
with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT (68); it now answers false for a display form whose spell carries
SPELL_ATTR0_ALLOW_WHILE_MOUNTED, so the mount is not refused. The aura script then puts
AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOUNT on 802117, and Unit::Mount removes auras carrying that flag after the mount
display is already set (Unit.cpp:11496 sets the mount, 11553 removes the flagged auras), so the mount lands
and the form and its model are released.
Evidence boundary: this observes native aura, display, cast-failure and mount state in a socketless
session. It does not cover the flight-master/taxi branch (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_ON_TAXI), rendered client

steps.label: Let login settle
Riding skill for the mount
Learn the mount and the form so neither cast can fail on a missing spellbook entry
Mount up first
SETUP: the mount is up
Clear the mount's global cooldown
Enter Draconic Aspect while mounted
DISCRIMINATING (R1): casting the form dismounts the caster
DISCRIMINATING (R1): the form is accepted, not refused
DISCRIMINATING (R2): the form survives the dismount
R2: the Dracthyr model is shown
Mount up while the form is active
DISCRIMINATING (R3): the mount lands instead of being refused
DISCRIMINATING (R3): mounting cancels Draconic Aspect
R3: the native model is restored by the mount
CONTROL: dismount through the client's mount-cancel request
CONTROL: the mount is gone
CONTROL: cast the form on foot
CONTROL: the on-foot cast is accepted and applies the form
Restore the native state
Leaving the form restores the native model
